about: The five everyday jobs every tool is asked to do, in the same words. A tool with no entry for a task is skipped and the report says so. Valendata inputs marked verify are checked against the skill (valendata info <slug>) before the first paid run. fields_map renames a tool's own field names to the task's (the skill says event_text where the task says headline), so every tool is scored on the same fields.

tasks.title: Wikipedia current events (latest 5)
tasks.prompt: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events and return the 5 most recent news items as JSON objects with: date, headline, link.

truth.how: the headline text appears on the page fetched when the run ends

tasks.title: Walmart search "air fryer", top 10
tasks.prompt: Search Walmart (https://www.walmart.com) for "air fryer" and return the top 10 products as JSON objects with: name, price, rating, link.

valendata.note: No Walmart skill in the marketplace yet: create one first (valendata or the app), then put its slug here.

tasks.title: Instagram profile @nasa
tasks.prompt: Open the Instagram profile https://www.instagram.com/nasa/ and return JSON with: followers, bio, and the latest 12 posts (link, caption, likes).

valendata.note: The marketplace Instagram skill has failed every run: build a fresh one first.

tasks.title: Google Maps "dentists in Austin", top 10
tasks.prompt: On Google Maps, search "dentists in Austin, TX" and return the top 10 results as JSON objects with: name, phone, website, rating.

tasks.title: Zillow homes for sale in Austin, top 10
tasks.prompt: On Zillow, find homes for sale in Austin, TX and return the first 10 as JSON objects with: address, price, beds, link.
